incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated error rate + tail latency observed in continuous-batching path -> KV table thrash detected for region-eu-1 (auto-generated).
Maria G: seeing a spike in 5xx and worker OOMs on cont-batcher nodes, looks like eviction storms on kvcache. Paging and disk I/O climbing.
Jamal S: copying dashboards now. How widespread? any customer-facing 5xx?
Maria G: yes — spike aligns with a customer-heavy seq workload around 2026-11-03T09:32Z. A subset of long-seq requests triggered huge batches (max_batch_tokens effectively unbounded for this route).
Lee H: that sounds like the max_batch_tokens got bumped in the route override earlier this week. If batches grow too large they pressure kvcache and cause thrash -> paging -> latency cliff.
Ana P: Support Ops, please attach customer list and SLA risk.
Support Ops: two paid customers reporting degraded responses (slow or 502s) in EU; support cases opened, escalating to SEs.
Jamal S: immediate mitigation plan: 1) limit incoming batch size (max_batch_tokens -> 512), 2) cap max_num_seqs to smaller per-request value (-> 6), 3) enable per-request timeout/failfast for long prefix workload, 4) route noisy customers to fallback low-memory model variant. Anyone object?
Lee H: agree. Also enable short-term KV cache eviction throttle to avoid simultaneous full-table rewrites.
Maria G: I'll take lead. Applying quick patch to runtime config now and will canary in region-eu-1. Command I'm running:```rbctl patch config cont-batcher --env=prod --set continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens=512 --set continuous_batching.max_num_seqs=6 --set continuous_batching.request_timeout_ms=60000```
deploy-bot: Starting config patch job cont-batcher@prod (job id cb-patch-206501)
deploy-bot: Canary in eu-1 started on 3 nodes; rollout strategy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual promote)
Maria G: canary health looks good on first 3 nodes, latency down ~40% on tail, error rate trending down. Proceeding to 50%.
Jamal S: while we roll this, throttle ingress for the noisy route:```rate-limit apply --route /v1/generate/longseq --qps 25```
Maria G: applied rate limit. Observed disk IO falloff and kvcache hit-rate improving.
Support Ops: notified affected customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA in 24h.
Ana P: flagging this for on-call handoff and postmortem. Need customer impact summary: which accounts, duration, and whether data consistency or PII exposed.
Lee H: no evidence of data leakage. Impact is availability/degraded latency only. Affected accounts: cust-eu-42, cust-eu-77. Window ~09:30Z-09:55Z (reduced to minimal after patch).
Maria G: full rollout to prod completed at 09:50Z, error rate back to baseline by 09:53Z. Leaving rate-limit in place for 30m to observe.
Jamal S: creating incident handoff note for next oncall (include root cause hypothesis: route-level override increased max_batch_tokens causing very large effective batches that exhausted KV cache working set and induced paging/evictions). Proposed permanent fixes: route config validation, autosane upper bounds for max_batch_tokens, tenant-level caps, and test harness for long-seq workloads.
Maria G: adding logs snippet for the hot window:
```
[09:33:12] cont-batcher[worker-17]: kvcache_evictions=4821 kvcache_hit_rate=0.03 mem_used=95% paging_io=high
[09:34:01] cont-batcher[worker-12]: error=backend_oom serving_seq_id=xyz-12345
[09:35:45] router: queue_depth=312 avg_batch_tokens=23456
```
Jamal S: I'm going to handoff to next oncall, summary below. Please paste into the oncall thread: "Eviction storm caused by route override allowing oversized continuous batches -> kvcache thrash -> paging -> customer-facing 5xx. Mitigations applied: patch to cap max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs, request timeout enabled, ingress rate-limit, and kvcache eviction throttle. Postmortem & config guardrails required."
Maria G: noted. I'll follow up with a short blameless postmortem draft and timeline. Adding issue: #INC-eviction-storm-206501 to track fixes (validation, tenant caps, e2e test).
Ana P: assign eng-runtime and eng-sre owners for permanent fixes. Also baseline tests for long-seq traffic in CI.
Support Ops: updating support tickets and asking affected customers if they'd like extended credits.
deploy-bot: Completed rollout (job id cb-patch-206501) — 100% nodes patched.
Jamal S: last check — tail latency 95th/99th down to expected; error pages reduced to pre-incident baseline. Closing the immediate incident, handing to oncall follow-up.
Maria G: handoff complete. Next steps: write postmortem, push config validators, and add synthetic long-seq test.
Ana P: thanks everyone. Please add timeline and customer impact to the postmortem. :thumbsup:
